 Order

This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellant(s) assailing the impugned award dated 30.05.2024 passed by 2nd Additional Member MACT, Manawar, Dist. Dhar (M.P.) in Claim Case No.30/2022, whereby an amount of Rs.7,05,000/- along with interest has been awarded to the survivors of the deceased Pramila, who passed away in road traffic accident which occurred on 08.04.2021 involving the offending vehicle motorcycle No. MP-11 N.D. 1675.
2.

Learned counsel for the appellant(s) submits that the income of the deceased has been assessed as Rs.3,000/- which is on the lower side, whereas as per the circular issued under the Minimum Wages Act by the Labour Department of State of Madhya Pradesh, the income of an unskilled labour NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8665 2 MA-6759-2024 on the date of incident is Rs.8,700/-.

entities.text: Labour Department of State of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: On these submissions, he prays for allowing the appeal by enhancing the award amount.

3 . Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/Insurance Company has opposed the prayer with further submission that 50% has been awarded in the head of future prospects which should be 40%
and prays for passing appropriate order.
Heard and considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
4. In light of the aforesaid, where the income of the deceased is taken on guess work, Circular issued under the Minimum Wages Act should be resorted to.

Accordingly, on the date of accident i.e. on Decd. Pramila W/O Mohan Through Lrs ... vs Nirmal on 2 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68162885/
1 08.04.2021 income of the deceased is to be taken as Rs.8700/- considering him as 'Unskilled Labour' and for this judgment passed by the Apex Court in Chandra @ Chanda @ Chandraram &
Anr. vs. Mukesh Kumar Yadav , (2022) 1 SCC 198 shall be referred.

sentences.text:
5. Accordingly, the just and proper compensation comes as under:-
Rs.8,700/- pm + 40% FP Loss of Dependency: X 12 Months - 1/3rd PE X Multiplier of 15 = Rs.14,61,600/-
 Consortium: Rs.1,32,000/-
 Loss of Estate: Rs.16,500/-
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-IND:8665 3 MA-6759-2024 Funeral:
Rs.16,500/-
 Total Amount: Rs.16,26,600/-
 MACT Awarded: Rs.7,05,000/-
 Enhanced Amount: Rs.9,21,600/-
6 .
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.16,26,600/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.7,05,000/-.
Accordingly, the appellant(s) are entitled to an enhanced amount of Rs.9,21,600/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.

7 . The appeal is valued as Rs.2 Lakh and for the rest of the amount, the claimant(s) will pay the requisite Court fees within a period of 30 days from today and only thereafter enhanced amount will be disbursed.
In case the appellant(s) fails to pay the requisite Court fees within a period of 30 days then beyond 30 days interest will not be payable till filing of the Court fees.
The enhanced amount shall also carry interest at the same rate, which was fixed in the impugned award and the other terms and conditions of the impugned award shall remain intact.
8 . Accordingly, the appeal stands partly allowed and disposed off in above terms.
